failures: Retry database readiness on connection failure

corrections.cause: Initial regression tests used Queue::fake and missed payload retry expiry at dispatch time
corrections.fix: Measure one-hour retry window from scheduled availability
corrections.prevention: Database queue payload and actual worker execution tests for absolute, integer, interval, immediate and past delays
corrections.verification: Before fix:3 future-delay scenarios failed,2 immediate/past scenarios passed

environmentNotes: All data services were isolated Docker containers on a dedicated network, without published ports or persistent volumes.
Initial broad run hit existing host-file ownership on logs; rerun used writable tmpfs logs and Pest temporary cache, without changing host permissions.
Initial full PostgreSQL run exceeded base-image128MB PHP memory limit; final successful run used512MB.
Node/Python suites and complete production-image build not rerun; no service source or dependency changes.
